decision.userPreference: Reliability preferred; approximately 6–8 seconds per short page accepted. Dense table measured 17.424 seconds with Gemma; no general latency guarantee.
basis: Same critical fields recovered by both vision models on the three fixtures.
Gemma has lower measured neuron use and latency than Qwen3.8 on this sample.
Tesseract remains faster; synthetic field recovery supports the optional visual path.
Additional 40-row fictitious price table: both models preserve all 80 HT/TTC amount/code associations; Gemma measured 17.424 s and 51.864 neurons, Qwen3.8 42.167 s and 614.741 neurons.

On the recorded purchase-order business response, source-role validation removes two unsupported suggestions while retaining the three expected fields. This is an offline validation fix, not a new model inference.

limits: Three short fictitious French pages plus one printed 40-row price table; one run per model and image.

comparison.scoring: Fixed fixture labels; dates normalized to ISO and money to integer cents. Critical score: six invoice fields per invoice, five order fields. Signature excluded from common text scores.

baseline.differences: Docker stamping uses fra+eng+ita. Italian traineddata absent in this repository. Browser version7 vs system5. Shared image variant uses exact fixture JPEG; stamping300dpi variant matches Python render_ocr geometry/grayscale.

limitations: This is Cloudflare's adaptive analytics dataset; billing records were unavailable with the integration's current OAuth permissions.
The dataset returns requestSource=unknown for every historical row. It cannot identify whether a request originated from app.cdinnov.eu, another application, or a manual test.
The 2026-11-07 audit/comparison traffic is excluded from this 30-complete-day baseline. A day without a returned analytics row is shown as zero.
The Cloudflare account subscription plan could not be verified through the Billing API (HTTP 403). The public 10,000 neurons/day allowance is used as the requested comparison.
